parameters.query: SELECT office_name, device_type, asset_count, held_by_person, held_by_team, open_rental_risk_flags, asset_count_prior_week, delta_vs_prior_week FROM v_weekly_it_summary ORDER BY office_name, device_type;

INSERT INTO report_weekly_snapshot (snapshot_date, office_id, device_type_id, asset_count)
SELECT date_trunc('week', current_date)::date, office_id, device_type_id, count(*)
FROM assets
GROUP BY office_id, device_type_id
ON CONFLICT (snapshot_date, office_id, device_type_id)
DO UPDATE SET asset_count = EXCLUDED.asset_count;

INSERT INTO report_log (run_name, rows_pushed, api_response_status, status)
VALUES ('{{ $json.run_name }}', {{ $json.rows_pushed }}, '{{ $json.api_response_status }}', '{{ $json.status }}');
